data_classification: synthetic example inputs; no employer, customer or personal data

assumptions.name: capacity measurement is the input, not the output
assumptions.statement: measured_capacity_hours_per_dev_week is an input the reader measures on their own eligible tasks; the model does not estimate it and no vendor figure is used as a default.

assumptions.name: review overhead is subtracted from gross capacity, never added as a separate cost
assumptions.statement: review_overhead_hours_per_dev_week reduces the hours counted as released. Counting the same review hours again as an incremental cost would double count them.

assumptions.name: realization_pct is a scenario dial
assumptions.statement: realization_pct converts released capacity into work the organization counts as useful. 25/50/75 are illustrative scenario values, not published enterprise benchmarks.

assumptions.name: loaded rate is a planning rate
assumptions.statement: loaded_hourly_rate_usd includes salary, benefits and overhead allocated by the reader. It values capacity; it does not prove cash moved.

assumptions.name: 46 working weeks
assumptions.statement: Annualization uses 46 weeks to leave room for leave, holidays and non-project time.

assumptions.name: no discounting or cash-flow timing
assumptions.statement: The model reports a single yearly rate, not NPV or IRR. Multi-year evaluation should discount explicitly and state the rate.

assumptions.name: no vendor benchmark is embedded
assumptions.statement: No published ROI figure (including the Forrester TEI result) is used as a default input or a comparison target.

assumptions.name: benefit_is_cash is always no
assumptions.statement: The output column benefit_is_cash is literally 'no' for every row: the model values released capacity and cannot establish avoided expenditure.
